description: This file defines the class PatternEndpointProvider, which provides endpoint configurations based on pattern matching of region and service identifiers within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: PatternEndpointProvider
classes.description: A class that provides AWS endpoints based on configurable endpoint pattern mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with an array of endpoint pattern configurations.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Returns the endpoint configuration matching the given arguments, using pattern matching.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands a pattern configuration into a full endpoint URL with substituted variables.
